This plugin automates the whole chain:"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"### How it detects problems (important to understand)"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"The guard does **not** statically inspect plugin code, and it does **not** try to "test" a plugin in"},{"id":"p9s2","text":" isolation. Detection works at three levels:"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"1. **Snapshots are pure file copies.** Taking a snapshot just copies 5 config files (`package.json`,"},{"id":"p10s2","text":" `pnpm-lock.yaml`, `pnpm-workspace.yaml`, `cordis.yml`, `cordis.patch.yml`). No plugin is run, no be"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"havior is evaluated."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"2. **Boot-level detection does run the harness — with your plugin loaded.** The `boot-guard` script "},{"id":"p11s2","text":"starts the whole `dsh web` process (which loads every installed plugin, including the one you just a"},{"id":"p11s3","text":"dded) and then health-checks HTTP `/` within a timeout. If a plugin breaks boot — load error, startu"},{"id":"p11s4","text":"p crash, unresponsive server — the check fails, and the guard automatically kills the tree, rolls ba"},{"id":"p11s5","text":"ck to the last good snapshot, and retries once. So **yes**: to catch a boot-breaking plugin, the har"},{"id":"p11s6","text":"ness (and therefore that plugin) has to actually start. That is the one moment where "running the pl"},{"id":"p11s7","text":"ugin" is part of detection. [该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"### Security notes"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"- The plugin only reads/writes profile config files and snapshots; it never executes third-party cod"},{"id":"p26s2","text":"e. `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` restores only the locked dependencies recorded in the snapshot.
"},{"id":"p26s3","text":"- Snapshots and incident reports are local files without credentials (credentials live elsewhere und"},{"id":"p26s4","text":"er `$DSH_HOME`, not in this directory layout).
- Automatic rollback happens only when the boot healt"},{"id":"p26s5","text":"h check fails; the guard never silently changes config during normal runtime."},{"id":"p27s1","text":"### Known limitations"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"- Incident auto-analysis covers **boot-failure class** incidents; for mid-session errors, run `dsh_r"},{"id":"p28s2","text":"ollback action=incident` manually to produce the same report.
- Bundle-plugin changes require a web "},{"id":"p28s3","text":"restart to take effect.
